result.description: Trio Nominees Pty Ltd   The Role   Reporting directly to the Director, the Office Manager will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, and reviewing the administrative functions of the business. This is a key management position responsible for ensuring efficient office operations while supporting business growth, staff coordination, and operational compliance.   Key Responsibilities    Plan, organise, direct, and coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the business.  Develop, implement, and review office management systems, policies, and procedures to improve efficiency and productivity.  Manage office budgets, purchasing, and administrative resources.  Coordinate office services, facilities management, equipment maintenance, and supplier contracts.  Supervise and support the sales consultants, including allocating workloads and monitoring performance.  Oversee company record management systems and ensure confidentiality and compliance with building legislative requirements.  Coordinate meetings, travel arrangements, company events, and executive administrative support to the CEO.  Assist with accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing, and liaison with external accountants.  Prepare business reports, correspondence, operational documentation, and management information.  Liaise with customers, suppliers, contractors, and external stakeholders to ensure effective business operations.  Monitor compliance with Workplace Health and Safety requirements and company policies.  Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems, business processes, and operational efficiency.    Essential Requirements    A relevant qualification  Diploma level or higher  in Business, Management, or a related discipline,  or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience  in lieu of formal qualifications.  Demonstrated experience in an Office Manager or similar management-level administrative position.  Strong leadership, organisational, and people management skills.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  High-level proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and business management software.  Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing or construction-related environment.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.    What We Offer    Permanent full-time position.  Competitive salary of  $80,000 – $90,000 plus superannuation , depending on skills and experience.  Supportive team environment.  Opportunities for professional development and career progression.  Work with a respected Australian manufacturer supplying innovative architectural products nationwide.    How to Apply   To apply, please submit your current resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.  Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.  About Company     About Us   Louvre House Pty Ltd is a well-established Australian manufacturer and supplier of premium aluminium louvre systems and architectural building products. We service residential, commercial, and industrial construction projects across Australia, delivering innovative products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the efficient management of the business.
